title: Coherence of comparison maps normalized on an immersion image
statement:
Let schemes be quasi-compact and locally Noetherian, with small pro-etale sites [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme, pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For each coefficient label $r$ give a cartesian system of commutative ring sheaves $R_X^r$, meaning coherent identifications $a^{-1}R_X^r=R_S^r$ for every immersion $a:S\hookrightarrow X$. Write $D(X,r)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_X^r))$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Use the exact extensions $E_a^r=a_{!,r}$, restriction isomorphisms $a_r^*E_a^r\cong1$, and factorization/composition maps $\gamma^r_{a,b}:E_a^rE_b^r\cong E_{ab}^r$ of [lem-sfb-locally-closed-extension-coherence].

Suppose functors $F_X^{rs}:D(X,r)\to D(X,s)$ have coherent isomorphisms $q_a^{rs}:a_s^*F_X^{rs}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_S^{rs}a_r^*$, respecting identity and composition. For open and closed immersions suppose isomorphisms $d_a^{rs}:F_X^{rs}E_a^r\xrightarrow{\sim}E_a^sF_S^{rs}$ are given whose restriction is $q_a^{rs}$ under $a^*E_a\cong1$. For a factorization $a=vc$ with $c$ closed and $v$ open, form $d_a=(E_v^s d_c)\circ(d_v E_c^r)$, inserting $\gamma$. These composites are independent of factorization, including comparison with open-then-closed factorizations, and satisfy
$$d_{ab}\circ F_X^{rs}(\gamma^r_{a,b})=\gamma^s_{a,b}F_T^{rs}\circ(E_a^s d_b)\circ(d_aE_b^r)$$
for $b:T\hookrightarrow S$.

If also natural isomorphisms $t_X:F_X^{st}F_X^{rs}\xrightarrow{\sim}F_X^{rt}$ are given and satisfy
$$q_a^{rt}\circ(a_t^*t_X)=(t_Sa_r^*)\circ F_S^{st}(q_a^{rs})\circ(q_a^{st}F_X^{rs}),$$
then the assembled comparisons satisfy
$$E_a^t(t_SM)\circ d_a^{st}(F_S^{rs}M)\circ F_X^{st}(d_a^{rs}M)=d_a^{rt}(M)\circ t_X(E_a^rM).$$
This is conditional coherence for already given comparisons; it asserts no existence of scalar-extension or pullback comparisons.
